authorization: 2026-10-20 user (verbatim): 把这套校正写进docs/loop-roadmap.md，并为第1项准备协议和代码.授权训练 — item 1 = the three-arm position-invariance comparison proposed in the same conversation.
question: Is the loss of composition at later hop positions (graph-B 3/4-hop, A/B shift asymmetry, failure at answer positions >= 5) caused by learned absolute positions binding fact lookups to the trained position, and does the convex carry alone, without the loop-native recipe, induce the one-hop-per-round solution?

input_origin.reuse: Exact existing 40000-example world and 43000-query panels used by every DiscoLoop/gate multi-hop arm

paired_recipe.note: Every arm's backbone at step 0 must equal the reused ungated DiscoLoop's step-0 model; handoff parameters are created without consuming the global RNG.

A0-discoloop-absolute-old.recipe: fixed R=4, final-round answer/EOS CE, constant LR after warmup, AdamW betas (0.9, 0.999), no EMA, CUDA graph

comparisons.position_new_recipe: ema-rope vs reused ema (absolute, loop-native recipe)
comparisons.position_old_recipe: disco-rope-old vs reused A0 (absolute, old recipe)
comparisons.carry_vs_recipe: ema-absolute-old vs reused ema (same carry and positions, recipe differs) and vs A0 (same recipe and positions, carry differs)

primary: 1500000-step endpoint, EMA shadow weights for every arm (raw also reported): graph-B two/three/four-hop and graph-A held-out four-hop answer accuracy at R8 from the R1-32 trace, the round at which each k-hop pool first reaches its endpoint accuracy, and 5-8 hop accuracy from the zero-training beyond-four-hop evaluation (run after training with the frozen panels and seed 2026102101). No best checkpoint or horizon is selected.

predictions.position: If absolute positions bind lookups to the trained position, ema-rope's graph-B three/four-hop at R8 exceed ema's (54.1/10.8 at 1.5M, EMA, R8 of the endpoint trace) by at least 15 percentage points each, and disco-rope-old's graph-B four-hop exceeds A0's 0%. If neither rises, the graph-B gap is not a position effect.
predictions.beyond: If the per-round operator is hop-invariant once positions are relative, ema-rope answers k-hop questions (k=5..8) above 5% at R16 with accuracy appearing from round k on; failure with RoPE means the operator does not extend beyond trained hop counts.
predictions.carry_vs_recipe: If the convex carry alone induces one hop per round, ema-absolute-old reaches graph-A held-out four-hop near 100% with k-hop formed at round k; if it memorizes trained chains in round 1 like the additive arms, the loop-native recipe is necessary.

limits: One previously observed development world and one initialization.
RoPE removes learned absolute positions entirely; it also changes the attention computation, so a RoPE effect is the effect of relative positions as implemented, not of any single property.
Old-recipe arms keep an EMA shadow for evaluation only; training is unchanged by it.
The decoded-feedback channel relies on next-token decodes being intermediate entities in this template.
